title: A routed ask or answered item shows one line on the waiting page and leaves when the owner marks it read
why: The Ask area is too crowded, and the owner rarely reads it, so asks that already have a home hide the ones that need his eyes.
note: Owner comment on the Ask area, thread b2ff97bf (09:11 CST Nov 10, relayed by the coordinator 09:14 CST): asks must not be ephemeral; each becomes a page question or a roadmap step plus a short reply. Blocked on page item 480 (ask-phase-out-rule), which asks how an ask leaves the area. Owner pick 480 a (09:14 CST Nov 10) with his note: read receipts; after the reply shows where it goes next, he marks it read (or fold) and it leaves. Shape: once an ask or an answered item is routed, it shows one line (its home, step:<slug> or item N, plus the short reply); the owner presses "Mark read" and it leaves the page; nothing is deleted, the record stays on its home. Covers the Ask area and the Answered row and section (owner comment thread 41ddef83, 09:13 CST: "this area stays here for too long too it's also done uneffectively"). Screen change in skills/waiting-page/page.html, so a designer goes first. Ready 09:16 CST Nov 10; the coordinator starts its lane. Related: page-feedback-to-template, page-thread-reply-refused. Gap (triage 10:56 CST Nov 10; folded by the coordinator 10:57 CST): a closed item leaves the page, so a thread reply that points to it leads nowhere. The owner asked "where was this question?" at 10:51 CST about item 480, which had closed and left. Fix in this step: a closed item stays as one line until the owner presses Mark read. Ruling (owner chat 11:26 CST Nov 10, relayed by the coordinator 11:31 CST): "sessions like triage are not being archived right? so it can be doing work via agents in its session/lane -- i just said no new spawns at this time". The freeze bars new sessions only; triage builds this step with agents in its own session (page item 492 closed). This note is the ruling's home until a decision holds it. Doing 11:35 CST: designer, design reviewer, test-author, builder and reviewer in triage. Design (designer opus, 11:51 CST Nov 10): mockup on branch design-ask-phase-out, head d9fdd4aa2, docs/design/ask-phase-out.html and ask-phase-out-notes.md; 13 states at 390/1280, light/dark. Triage defaults that keep today's behaviour (rule building-port-keeps-behaviour): the rail Answered row keeps today's chips; an answer not yet routed shows in full; no Mark all read control; a filing-pending answer shows as today. 'Mark read' and 'Mark unread' replace Dismiss and Restore (owner pick 480 a). Test-author started on branch ask-phase-out. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was triage [ended:cs-triage:-claude-settings-(6)] (agents)). Lane prose-waiting-page started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
